intro: Kravel Koalbeard says the Fool's Stout worked great. He has put money on the next race, hoping the crew you made drunk wrecked their own car. You carry a note about the successful test to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. This follows the pit crew you chose to make drunk.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That Fool's Stout worked great! I placed a bet on the next race, and... Let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!
There's only one more task for you -- take this note back to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. He'll want to know of the successful test.
And hopefully we can get more of that Fool's Stout for future races!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello friend. How'd that stout work out? It's strong stuff, isn't it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It says here that the fool's stout was a success. That's good news!
If you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of Zanzil's Mixture.
